objections.text: The agent id on a proposal (proposed_by) is not authenticated: it comes from the MCP client's name in the handshake or a local --agent flag, which any local configuration can set; it tells an agent from a person, which is what part 1's guarantee needs, but it is not proof of which host proposed. The ADR states the boundary.

The TypeSafe breaker is shared between the tool path (a propose's judge call, 3 s, no retries) and the background distillation: a run of failures on one side opens the breaker for the other until it half-opens. Acceptable for one key and one service; said in the ADR.
